remarks: Beautiful end unit townhouse for rent in the heart of Stamford. Steps away from downtown and Scalzi park, this 2 bedroom, 1.5 bathroom unit is tucked away in the far corner of the complex for maximum comfort and privacy. Gleaming hardwood floors, central air conditioning, and abundant natural light invite you as you step through the doors. A large living and dining room combination flows into the updated kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. A half bath finishes off the main level. Head upstairs and you will find two generous bedrooms with ample closet space, as well as a full bathroom. The walkout lower level contains a washer/dryer, attached garage, and a flexible finished space, perfect for an office/den/living area. Step out of the back door to a private patio overlooking a large green space. The association offers FREE WIFI, has a pool, and plenty of visitor parking. Everything that Stamford has to offer is at your fingertips at this centrally located townhouse. Schedule your tour today!
